== Article notes ==

=== Marginal cuts ===
* Tournament-legal date 21 December 2009 (star-wars.pl and the Players Committee homepage capture, both in Virtual Block 6 External links) left out; the PDF does not give it.
=== Build notes ===
* Card list taken from the slip captions in [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_2.pdf VirtualBlock6_2.pdf] (the title above each slip, not the original-card label in its corner); links follow the [[Virtual Block 6]] card list. Sides come from the PDF's Dark Side and Light Side pages.
* Article created as a test for Bill; title uses the "(Virtual Block N)" suffix for all twelve releases because Domain Of Evil, Scoundrels and Republic At War already have pages. Source PDF not yet saved to the Internet Archive (queued).
